items.tagline: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block

steps.title: Follow Flop Labs on X
steps.body: Follow the official Flop Labs X account and turn on notifications. This is the only requirement the project has published for eligibility, and it is where testnet dates will land first.

steps.title: Follow Arthur Hayes for early terms
steps.body: Follow CryptoHayes and subscribe to his Substack. His essays have carried more detail than the project account, including the 20% testnet figure, and more are coming. Terms tend to surface there first.

steps.title: Apply for a network role
steps.body: Open the Flop website and submit the form matching what you can deliver. Three of the four roles are open: GPU provider or miner: for anyone with hardware that can run inference. Miners earn block rewards plus payment per job. No minimum specifications have been published, so treat any circulating hardware requirement as unverified. Validator: confirms miners completed their assigned work and stores agent memory. Suited to people comfortable running nodes. KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the form is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak. The fourth role, Agents, is the demand side: they spend $FLOP rather than earn it, so there is nothing to apply for.

steps.title: Start publishing $FLOP content now
steps.body: If you took the creator route, post before the program formally opens. There is no leaderboard yet, and if scoring ends up mindshare-based it will likely be applied retroactively. Stay on theme: decentralized inference, GPU economics, Hayes’ argument that the AI buildout is a debt problem rather than a technology one.

steps.title: Get ready for the Q4 testnet
steps.body: The 20% allocation is earned on the testnet, which has not opened. Hold off on configuring a wallet for a specific network, because Flop Labs has not named the chain. Watch the official account and be ready to onboard when it goes live.

items.description: The airdrop is confirmed. items.name: Ethena
items.tagline: Ethena runs a seasonal rewards program where users earn points called “Sats” for holding and deploying USDe, staking ENA

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Ethena App
steps.body: Go to the Ethena app and click “Connect Wallet.” Ethena supports MetaMask, WalletConnect, and other major Ethereum wallets. Make sure you are on Ethereum mainnet, since staking happens on the production network.

steps.title: Acquire Stablecoins or ENA
steps.body: You need stablecoins to mint USDe, and optionally ENA to stake for the highest base multiplier. If you do not already hold these, buy them from Binance and withdraw to your wallet: USDT, USDC, DAI, or FRAX to mint USDe ENA to stake and lock as sENA Keep some ETH on hand for gas.

steps.title: Mint USDe
steps.body: Open the “Buy” section in the Ethena app and swap your stablecoins for USDe. Holding USDe starts accruing Sats automatically.

steps.title: Stake USDe for sUSDe
steps.body: Navigate to the “Stake” section and convert USDe into sUSDe. This earns protocol yield from funding rates on top of your Sats.

steps.title: Stake and Lock ENA for sENA
steps.body: Go to the staking section, stake your ENA to receive sENA, then lock it. Locking sENA carries one of the strongest Sats multipliers in the program (reported around 40x), and longer lock durations increase the boost. Locked sENA also accrues points for partner ecosystems including Ethereal , Derive, and Echelon.

steps.title: Deploy Into Partner Protocols
steps.body: Route your USDe and sUSDe through integrated DeFi platforms to stack additional multipliers. Options include: Pendle USDe markets, which have offered the highest reported boosts (up to 60x) USDe/sUSDe liquidity pools for roughly 30x Yield vaults such as Strata and Ethereal, also around 30x Check current multipliers in the app before committing, since rates shift between partners and seasons.

steps.title: Farm Cross-Chain on Solana and Avalanche
steps.body: USDe works beyond Ethereum, and activity on other chains qualifies for points and ecosystem rewards. Bridge USDe using a service like the bridge below, then connect a Solana or Avalanche wallet on the Sats page to keep earning across networks. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Track Your Sats and Claim at Season End
steps.body: Monitor your accumulated Sats on the Ethena dashboard during the season. When Season 6 closes, return to the official claim portal, connect the same wallet, and claim your ENA. Keep ETH available for the claim transaction.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Huma App
steps.body: Open the official Huma Finance application and connect your Solana wallet. Huma 2.0 is permissionless and requires no KYC, so you can move straight to depositing once connected.

steps.title: Choose Your Farming Strategy
steps.body: Open the Deposit section and pick the mode that fits your goal: Classic : Earns real yield (around 10.5% APY, updated monthly) plus a base rate of Feathers. Best if you want returns alongside airdrop points. Maxi : Earns 0% APY but generates up to 5x the Feathers of Classic mode. Best if you are optimizing purely for allocation.

steps.title: Deposit USDC and Receive PST
steps.body: Enter your deposit amount and confirm the transaction. In return you receive $PST, a liquid LP token that represents your position and accrues Feathers automatically. You can swap $PST back to USDC on Solana venues like Jupiter or Meteora to exit, though unwinding early reduces the Feathers you accumulate.

steps.title: Lock Your Position for Bonus Feathers
steps.body: This step is optional. Committing your deposit to a fixed 3-month or 6-month lock multiplies the Feathers you earn over that period. Only lock capital you are comfortable leaving in place, since locked positions cannot be withdrawn until the term ends.

steps.title: Stake HUMA for Extra Feathers
steps.body: If you hold HUMA, staking it earns additional Feathers on top of your LP rewards, with no fixed lockup. Holding $PST while staking adds a further boost, and keeping tokens staked for six months unlocks Vanguard status. Unstake any time.

steps.title: Check Eligibility and Claim
steps.body: If you farmed in a completed season, head to the eligibility checker , connect your wallet, and claim your HUMA on Solana. The Season 4 checker is live now. For the next round, keep monitoring your Feathers balance in the Huma app and claim again once its snapshot is taken and the window opens.
